semantics.precision_scope: A campus locator may point to another constituent of a multi-building campus. It is not asserted to be the footprint or centroid of the selected new building. The named owner asset page provides the Supermanzana 6 campus address and LOCATION link. The captured 302 Location is a literal latitude/longitude search query. Coordinates are copied in reversed order for GeoJSON, without geocoding or selecting a map viewport.
